I'd be happy to help analyze a poem, but I don't see any poem text in your message - just empty quotation marks after the opening quote.

Could you please share the actual poem you'd like me to:
1. Analyze
2. Proofread
3. Title
4. Expand into a story

Once you paste the content, I can assist with literary analysis and creative writing. I should mention that while I can engage with romantic and sensual themes in a literary context, I do have some limits around explicit sexual content, so the level of detail I can provide may depend on what direction the material takes.

Please share the poem and I'll do my best to help!
